blurb: Your own project's path dependencies can point anywhere, but a dependency's own path dependencies are honoured only when they stay inside the workspace: a path out of it names a directory that need not exist where the package is used. A fetched package's path dependencies are never honoured. Move the target into the workspace.
example:
# lib/bynk.toml, a dependency of the project
[dependencies]
core = { package = "acme/core", path = "../../outside" }   // ✗ outside the workspace

core = { package = "acme/core", path = "../core" }         // ✓ a workspace member
summary: A path dependency declared by a dependency resolves outside the workspace; a dependency's own path dependencies are honoured only between members of one workspace.
